task: Assistant conversation is lost during page refresh (EPMCDME-14797)

key_reasoning.reason: Touches both backend conversation handling, streaming disconnect resilience, and frontend store/polling/stop mechanism.
Risk of concurrency when front-end polls while backend is still saving. Decoupling TCP disconnection from cancellation requires robust state tracking.
Approximately 5 files across backend and frontend repos, plus test suites.
Spans database entities, API routers, stream-processing handlers, background thread supervision, Valtio state stores, and utility components.
